summary.composition: Explicit groves, retained-grove extensions, understorey skirts and broken coastal borders. Intentional overlapping crowns; clear trunk contacts, roads and resident approaches.

reservation.note: 1300 x 800 quiet lawn reservation. Native Home 700 x 410 SVG mound and native island-scale furniture. Only furniture footprints are solid.

sleepers.pocketNote: Five new residents per review pocket. S7/S8 and S10 extend onto adjoining grove margins because the proposal ellipses are capacity reservations, not hard boundaries.
